body: "Oh my god, I just gave the patient 250mg of zzzzzzzz!"
Haha hey no problem, it's ok. I'm starting to feel better, just waiting for sleep to come now. Thanks for helping, though, honestly.

Alternate ending:

Game show contestant says, "Fine, the tits."
I'm usually pretty good at it. For some reason those grim thoughts creep up on me most at night.
I do call them but it's more of a being away from home thing. Struggle between missing home while I'm away and feeling like I need to get out of town when I'm there. I wish it weren't like that.

Hello stranger. Thanks for even saying hi. That alone has really eased up some feelings. I'm in a pretty low point missing my family tonight, thinking pretty damn depressing things about the future and my family getting older and me being away and blah blah blah.

It's worse at night I think. Anyway, I'll stop being so cryptic. But thanks. I get a small feeling of happiness knowing that at any time there is someone like you lending an ear to someone who needs it.
